mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 4.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.8% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in industrial production signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE rising and INDPRO falling does not produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for two consecutive months), further rate increases compress equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 2000 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate signals a supply shock and labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of INDPRO falling and UNRATE rising does not produce negative 60d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core CPI above 2.5% annually signals rising inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom (HOUST > 2000 thousand units), strong consumer spending and economic growth drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST > 2000.
